info.name: ClaimsHub API
info.description:
Local assessment API. Start docker compose, Claims.Api and Claims.Worker first.

Run the whole collection in order (Runner) - logins store tokens, created claim ids are chained between requests.

exec: // incidentDate = yesterday (incident dates cannot be in the future)
